content: Clipboard managers (Maccy, CopyQ, GPaste) establish the table-stakes bar for local plaintext history: bounded history size so old entries roll off, an explicit user-invoked clear, an ignore/exclusion list so sensitive sources are never recorded (Maccy honours the macOS 'concealed' pasteboard flag set by 1Password/Bitwarden), optional clear-on-quit, and optional at-rest encryption (CopyQ encrypted items). All keep data local by default. The pattern is: cap + clear + exclude, all three, not just one.
